audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart hands Kennen levels 3, 4-5 and first item, and calls level 2 a coin flip — the page's own whys say Fiora owns 1-3 and the middle stages are skill.
audit.why: whys[1] says you beat his shuriken, whys[2] calls level 2-3 'your hardest pre-6 window', whys[3]/[4]/[5] each explicitly say skill check / even; only whys[6] gives it to Kennen. packet.levelChart agrees exactly.
audit.corrected: win[1], win[2] -> Fiora; win[3], win[4], win[5] -> Skill; win[6] stays Kennen, with phases mirrored and ratings rebalanced.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every 'track Lightning Rush' line is number-free, so the player never knows how long the window lasts.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6, Thundering Shuriken 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4, Slicing Maelstrom a flat 120s; Fiora W is 24s, R 110s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry 10s, 7s/4s, 120s, 24s and 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions absent: Electrical Surge is on-hit magic damage that scales with attack speed (so armour misreads the trade), and Lightning Rush ignores unit collision, so minions never block his escape or his engage.
audit.why: Riot's text: W passively deals extra damage and marks on attack, E 'enables him to pass through units'. The 'Build MR' do had generic filler text under it instead of the reason.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states the on-hit/attack-speed scaling; breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d state that Lightning Rush passes through units. The existing Riposte-parries-the-stun claim is CORRECT here — Mark of the Storm's 3-stack stun is an immobilizing effect, so Riposte returns a stun.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Out-duel when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — 10s at rank 1, and it passes through units, so minions never block his exit. - Riposte: 24s, spend it on his third Mark. - Grand Challenge: 110s — kill windows only.

edits.before: His escape. Out-duel when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His escape — 10s at rank 1, and it ignores unit collision. Duel him off it.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Kennen, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Electrical Surge is on-hit magic damage that scales with his attack speed — MR, not armour, reads this trade.

edits.before: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Kennen spends Lightning Rush — commit at once, it is 10s down.

edits.before: That is Kennen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken is 7s at rank 1 and 4s maxed — step up on its cooldown.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks stun you — parry the third and the stun becomes yours.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s of AOE marks — fight in it only with Riposte up, never inside your grouped team.

notes: No fabricated names in this matchup — the content layer is already the strongest of Fiora's slice. The Riposte-parries-the-stun advice in spikes[1], mid and wants.you[2] is mechanically correct and was left intact.
